Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Bromodomain-containing protein 4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs to activities for provenance. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records to activities for compound_key. Filter by target name 'Bromodomain-containing protein 4' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
